sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: pAdapAtisama dEvanikaAya! harE sisusOma manOhara! phAla dhEsha vilasitha mrgamadha thilaka!
sUditArigana! nirupamabala! bala sOdarANga hari chandana charchitha!

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: bOgi bhOga kalitAtmanivAsa vibhO! vihagEshvara vAhana! pUrna kAma! kalidOsha vinAshakara!
yOgi jAtha hRdyAmbujakhElana! sAragrAdhika gambhIra! murAnthaka!

sections.title: charaNam3
